name: Frigid Maw
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target your animal companion or self (if applicable)
Duration 1 minute/level, see text
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); see text; Spell Resistance yes

Your or your animal companion’s bite attack deals an additional 1d4 points of cold damage, and the target is staggered for 1 round per 2 caster levels. A successful Fortitude save reduces the stagger effect to a -10 penalty to speed (minimum 0). The staggered effect and reduction in speed doesn’t stack from multiple attacks, but the duration resets if a newer bite would cause the ongoing damage to last longer or the effect would increase to staggered.

The cold does not harm you or the animal companion.
